description: Use this when the user asks which advertising awards they can enter, or when entries open. Returns advertising awards and their next entry period (open now / expected next), with the organizer, categories, entry fee and eligibility where known. Regional awards are returned only when a matching prefecture is given, and are listed first. International awards are returned only when `includeInternational` is true. `category` is one of: TVCM / WEB動画 / ラジオCM / 新聞 / 雑誌 / OOH交通 / デジタルWeb / PR / BtoB / キャンペーン総合 / デザイン / パッケージ / 学生 / その他. Dates are for reference only.

includeInternational.description: Set true to include international awards. Default false.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Default 15, maximum 30.

openOnly.description: Set true to return only awards accepting entries now.

prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture, in Japanese (e.g. 香川県). Adds the regional awards for that prefecture.

role.description: The user's position: company = a business commissioning production or advertising / creator = a videographer, editor or other creator / agency = an advertising agency or production company.

name: find_ad_awards

error.description: Reason the request could not be answered, in Japanese.

message.description: Message for the user, in Japanese.

needRole.description: true when the call was made without `role`; nothing else is returned.

notAvailable.description: true when the tool is not available for the given role.

note.description: Notes that apply to the result, in Japanese.
